# contact

Public contact form backend: the contact bundled feature with its required companions (delivery, user-data-rights, files) and the anonymous browser client.

## README

# Recipe: contact

Public contact form backend. The `contact` bundled feature stores questions, contact
requests and problem reports from website visitors and notifies every SystemAdmin (mail,
optional Telegram). The notification names only the kind, the app and a link into the inbox:
no name, address, phone, subject or message. Telegram is a third party where nothing can be
shredded or recalled, so it gets the same minimal text. Website senders get a fixed
acknowledgement that repeats nothing they typed; signed-in admin reports get a copy.
SystemAdmins reply from the admin. Phone is off and Telegram is not mounted unless the app
turns them on (`fields.phone`, `telegram: true`).

**What the recipe demonstrates:**
- Mounting `createContactFeature` with its companions (delivery, user-data-rights, files)
- The anonymous flow: `contact:query:challenge` hands out a proof-of-work challenge,
  `contact:write:submit` verifies it; spam gets the same 200 body and stores nothing
- The browser client at `GET /contact/client.js` (`window.KumikoContact.load()` / `submit()`)

## Layout

```
samples/recipes/contact/
├── package.json
├── README.md
└── src/
    ├── feature.ts                      # createContactFeature options
    └── __tests__/
        └── feature.integration.test.ts # challenge query + client route
```

The behavior (submit, silent drops, replies, Telegram, GDPR export and erasure, retention) is
covered by the integration tests next to the feature in
`packages/bundled-features/src/contact/__tests__/`.

## Run tests

```bash
bun test --config=bunfig.integration.toml samples/recipes/contact
```

## Integration into a real app

1. Mount `createContactFeature({ appName })` plus delivery, a mail channel, `user-data-rights`,
   `files` with a file provider, and `config`/`secrets` for the Telegram bot token.
2. Run `kumiko schema generate` (new tables, plus the delivery `idempotency_key` column).
3. SystemAdmins set `contact:config:reply-to` and `contact:config:telegram-chat` in the admin.
4. Embed `/contact/client.js` on the website; the form is yours.

```ts
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { createAuthFoundationFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/auth-foundation";
import {
  createChannelEmailFeature,
  createInMemoryTransport,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/channel-email";
import { createComplianceProfilesFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/compliance-profiles";
import { createConfigFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/config";
import { createDataRetentionFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/data-retention";
import { createDeliveryFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/delivery";
import { createFileFoundationFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/file-foundation";
import { createFileProviderInMemoryFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/file-provider-inmemory";
import { createFilesFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/files";
import { createNotesHistoryFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/notes-history";
import { createSessionsFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/sessions";
import { createTenantFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/tenant";
import { createUserFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/user";
import { createUserDataRightsFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/user-data-rights";
import { SYSTEM_TENANT_ID } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { setupTestStack, type TestStack } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { contactFeature } from "../feature";

let stack: TestStack;

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({
    features: [
      createConfigFeature(),
      createUserFeature(),
      createTenantFeature(),
      createDeliveryFeature(),
      createChannelEmailFeature({
        transport: createInMemoryTransport(),
        resolveEmail: async () => null,
      }),
      createFilesFeature(),
      createFileFoundationFeature(),
      createFileProviderInMemoryFeature(),
      createDataRetentionFeature(),
      createComplianceProfilesFeature(),
      createAuthFoundationFeature(),
      createSessionsFeature(),
      createUserDataRightsFeature(),
      createNotesHistoryFeature(),
      contactFeature,
    ],
    anonymousAccess: { defaultTenantId: SYSTEM_TENANT_ID },
  });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

describe("contact sample", () => {
  test("an anonymous visitor gets a proof-of-work challenge and the form options", async () => {
    const res = await stack.http.raw("POST", "/api/query", {
      type: "contact:query:challenge",
      payload: {},
    });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const body = (await res.json()) as { data: { challenge: string; bits: number; phone: string } };
    expect(body.data.bits).toBe(8);
    expect(body.data.phone).toBe("optional");
    expect(body.data.challenge.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  test("the browser client is served as JavaScript", async () => {
    const res = await stack.http.raw("GET", "/contact/client.js");
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.headers.get("content-type")).toContain("application/javascript");
    expect(await res.text()).toContain("KumikoContact");
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// Contact sample
//
// A public website form (question, contact request, problem report) that lands with the
// SystemAdmins: mail, optional Telegram, a copy to the sender. Spam is handled without a
// captcha: honeypot field, single-use proof-of-work challenge, minimum submit time, per-IP
// and per-email rate limits. Rejected submits answer 200 with the normal body.
//
// The website embeds the anonymous client the feature serves itself:
//   <script src="https://api.example.com/contact/client.js"></script>
//   const { kinds, phone } = await window.KumikoContact.load();
//   const result = await window.KumikoContact.submit({ kind, name, email, message, locale });
//   // result.kind: "sent" | "rate-limited" (retryAfterSeconds) | "failed"
//
// Prerequisites the app wires itself:
//  - `anonymousAccess` (defaultTenantId = SYSTEM_TENANT_ID) so the form needs no login
//  - delivery with a mail channel (and channel-telegram for the optional Telegram forward)
//  - a file provider, because the entities carry file fields
//  - `kumiko schema generate` for the new tables

import { createContactFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/contact";

export const contactFeature = createContactFeature({
  appName: "Sample App",
  fields: { phone: "optional" },
  // Lowered only to keep the sample test fast; the default (19 bits, 3 seconds) suits production.
  spamProtection: { proofOfWorkBits: 8, minSubmitSeconds: 0 },
});
```
